cohort: The study included 29 control pregnancies and 17 singleton pregnancies complicated by early preeclampsia, with 19 pregnancies from the normal group (28 to 34 weeks gestational age) selected for comparison.
finding: Placental DDVDmean was significantly decreased in early preeclampsia pregnancies compared to normal pregnancies, demonstrated high accuracy in discriminating between the two groups, and showed a linear decrease with increasing gestational age.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during pregnancy between 28 and 34 weeks of gestational age.
